purpose: Classify every pytest skip so no skip hides a claim-required capability or a defect. Required before freeze; the deselected count in a -k run is not a skip and is irrelevant here.
note_on_deselected: A directed run such as `pytest -k backend` reported '40 passed, 1 skipped, 368 deselected'. The 368 deselected are tests the -k filter did not select; they are neither failures nor skips. The suite-wide numbers are the ones that matter.

verified_by_running.defect_surfaced_by_the_audit: Running the previously-skipped SIGTERM integration test revealed a latent, pre-existing bug in scripts/run_lifecycle.py: `run_context.run_dir.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)` raised ValueError when the evidence root is outside the project (a pytest tmp dir). Fixed by falling back to the absolute path in that case. This is exactly why a skip must never be assumed benign.
